title: REQ · Remount restores the saved game state
summary: After unmount and remount the App restores the saved story and world state
description: Context: useGame initialises from readSaved() and writes on every state change; the intro gate (begun) is local state and resets on remount. Desired behavior: the inventory region is named so restored inventory is assertable alongside history and hotspot state. Expected result: with storage mocked in memory, state survives remount. Why: players must not lose progress.
acceptance_criteria: Given Search was performed and storage is the in-memory mock, when App is remounted and Begin clicked, then history shows the hidden door text and Bookshelf has data-open true
Given the mocked readSaved returns null, when App renders and Begin is clicked, then the opening dialogue is shown
definition_of_done: Inventory section exposes accessible name Inventory
